notes.subject: אליך
notes.rationale: 'to/against you' — most versions take hostile sense 'I am against thee'; literally 'I am upon/to you'.

notes.subject: צור המישר
notes.rationale: 'rock of the level' — epithet of Jerusalem; KJV 'rock of the plain', BSB 'rocky plateau', some read 'O rock, O plain' as vocatives.

notes.subject: यरूशलयिम (घाटी में बसली)
notes.rationale: Direct address to the inhabitress of the valley — Jerusalem — announcing judgement.

notes.subject: יחת
notes.rationale: From נחת 'descend/press down' — the boasters ask 'who shall come DOWN against us?', answered by YHWH's coming down upon them.

translation: देखऽ हम ⟨तोहरा बिरुद्ध⟩ हइ, हे घाटी में बसली, समथर के चट्टान — यहवे के बचन — जे कहऽ हथिन: कोनो हमनी के ऊपर नामतइ? आउ कोनो हमनी के घर में आतइ?
